__comment: Vanilla block/block, plus ambientocclusion:false, and deliberately WITHOUT a parent. BlockModel.hasAmbientOcclusion() reads the value from the ROOT of the parent chain - 'return this.parent != null ? this.parent.hasAmbientOcclusion() : this.hasAmbientOcclusion' - so a model that declares ambientocclusion:false while parented to block/block is silently ignored, because block/block does not declare it and therefore defaults to true. Vanilla never sets ambientocclusion on a parented model: all 131 vanilla block models that declare it are parentless. Any model in this mod that needs AO off must root here instead of at block/block. The display block below is copied verbatim from vanilla block/block so item rendering is unchanged.
